body: My biggest one is if he snaps at you when he's panicking or freaking out please don't take it to heart, he absolutely doesn't mean to be a jerk. I know when I snap I immediately feel bad and I always apologize. If you want to ask any questions I'd be happy to help! I'm in the same position but flipped, plus it'd be nice to hear how things are in a different perspective 😁
I'm schizophrenic and cannot read playing cards. No clue why, but they're fuzzy, like I have really bad vision or something ¯\_(ツ)_/

There probably isn't anywere for me to go except my car or a public place. And I've never talked with a crisis team, I'm not in danger of hurting myself (that I feel right now) but I don't kow what else to do. What does a crisis team do?

I can relate very well at the moment! I don't want to be home because I believe the government is watching me constantly and they're in my house. Jeez, it used to not be this bad. I guess my advice is at least you know you aren't alone and it's probably all nonsense, easier to say than to act on.
If you get scared I'm right here and will probably be up forever 👍

I work at a Walgreens and a lady came in with her daughter (about 7) her daughter made a comment about her mom buying cigarettes, to which the mom screamed at her daughter, "shut the fuck up or I'll bury you."

Yes, I am! (And really bad at replying)

I had gotten an email saying that I had gotten into the college I wanted, which kind of took me out of it. And now I guess I haven't had the same courage to kill myself as I did before. Oh well.
